name: Pantheon

checked_on: 2026-10-09 (author's own build; every cell reviewed against the code and its recorded live checks)
source_note: Author's own project (open source, pre-release, published as-is). Cells describe the author's current build, which is newer than the public repo (last updated 2026-09-28). Held to the same rules as every other tool here, weak spots included.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code and Codex; Codex runs as headless jobs only

harness_count.value: 2 (Claude Code, Codex); local-model adapter built, unused

approve_deny_prompt.value: Allow or deny from the deck; walked on a test deck only

conversation_gui_view.value: Recent actions and latest ask; no full chat view

real_terminal.value: Jumps to the session's own real tmux window

session_organization.value: Sidebar session list plus a live fleet table

usage_hud.value: Usage and resets from local logs and your account

burn_rate_forecast.value: Burn rate and run-out time; not yet checked against real use

limit_governor.value: Built but switched off by default; never tested live

vault_task_source.value: Reads your notes vault as its live task list

planner_orchestrator.value: None; the planning page only estimates usage cost

cross_provider_delegation.value: Codex hand-offs to Claude show in the deck; not walked live

always_on_assistant.value: Pinned Assistant session, used from desk and phone

builtin_editors_browser.value: Terminal editor pane beside a session; not walked live

native_mobile_app.value: None; your phone's terminal app over SSH instead

phone_no_new_app.value: Your phone's terminal app over SSH

prompt_scratchpad.value: Saved drafts, inserted without sending; not walked live

saved_prompt_library.value: None; an idea only, not specced or built

appearance_control.value: Writes your terminal's colors and font; not walked live

app_shell.value: Terminal UI (Python + Textual) in your own terminal

download_size.value: No installer; runs from source (git clone + Python)

stability_maturity.value: Personal, pre-release; stability fixes still under way
